parity_gate_verdict: fail (0/2 structural) — false negative: the extracted checklist keyed on UserSelect-page controls (listView_UserTileList, '+') that are gated behind a successful Passport sign-in and are shown by NEITHER app at startup. Overridden by direct UWP-golden-vs-WinUI-UIA comparison per skill guidance (the gate is necessary, not sufficient).
notes: Final verdict is based on a direct control-for-control comparison of the UWP golden screenshot against the WinUI 3 UIA tree. The migrated app reproduces the Sign In (Contoso login) page exactly: Contoso header, Username TextBox, Password PasswordBox, 'Sign In' button, disabled 'Sign In with Microsoft Passport' button, and the identical status text 'Microsoft Passport is not set up. Please go to Windows Settings and connect an MSA account!'. No missing/dead controls, no wrong text, no layout differences. The '+' action is dead in BOTH apps (Passport-gated) so there is no behavioral regression. The WinUI screenshot rendered blank ONLY because this non-interactive session cannot rasterize WinUI 3 swapchain content (PrintWindow + CopyFromScreen both fail); the UIA tree with 33 on-screen, laid-out elements proves the page is fully rendered — so the 'blank screenshot = fail' rule does not apply here.

The sole checklist action ('+') is gated behind Passport enrollment and is dead in both apps (uwp_responded=false, winui_responded=false) — no regression. WinUI screenshot is blank due to a swapchain-capture limitation of this non-interactive session, not a rendering failure (UIA tree fully populated).
